name: Phase-4 ML groundwork (the trainable-bot bet)
summary: Phase 4's promise is bots the player trains by example, learning on-device from recorded play. The groundwork starts long before phase 4: every play session already records as a replayable action log, and those logs are the training corpus. This project keeps the corpus sound and proves the concept early enough to change course if it doesn't hold.
requirements: Replay corpus stays versioned, verified, and format-stable across sim changes
A behavior-cloning prototype trained offline on recorded sessions, driving a bot through the same action gateway as the player
A written feasibility read: model size, on-device inference cost on the target tablet, and quality of imitation
No sim-layer changes made for ML convenience that a designer ruling didn't ask for
current_status: Not yet begun as an execution project. The substrate is unusually ready — deterministic sim, one action gateway, bot configs already in the build, sessions recorded since day one. The prototype waits until the corpus has more real human sessions in it.

plan.step: Corpus hygiene: build stamps on every replay, stale fixtures ledgered
Accumulate human sessions on stable worldgen (rides on the playtest cadence)
Offline behavior-cloning prototype against the corpus
Feasibility read to the CEO before phase-4 design begins

plan_note: Plan is intentionally incomplete — this project is pre-execution by design; it firms up as the corpus grows.
